verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in ruins.

segments.text: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in ruins.

verses.text: They have given the corpses of Your servants [as] food for the birds of the heavens, the flesh of Your holy ones for the beasts of the earth.

segments.text: They have given the corpses of Your servants [as] food for the birds of the heavens, the flesh of Your holy ones for the beasts of the earth.

verses.text: They have poured out their blood like the waters around Jerusalem, and there is none to bury them.

segments.text: They have poured out their blood like the waters around Jerusalem, and there is none to bury them.

verses.text: We have become a reproach for our neighbors, a mocking and derision for those around us.

segments.text: We have become a reproach for our neighbors, a mocking and derision for those around us.

verses.text: Until when, O YHWH? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

segments.text: Until when, O YHWH? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

verses.text: Pour out Your wrath toward the nations that have not known You, and upon the kingdoms that have not called on Your name!

segments.text: Pour out Your wrath toward the nations that have not known You, and upon the kingdoms that have not called on Your name!

verses.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and his habitation they have made desolate.

segments.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and his habitation they have made desolate.

verses.text: Do not remember the former iniquities against us; hurry to let Your compassion come, for we have been brought very low.

segments.text: Do not remember the former iniquities against us; hurry to let Your compassion come, for we have been brought very low.

verses.text: Help us, O God of our salvation! And deliver us, because of the glory of Your name, and cover over our sins for the sake of Your name.

segments.text: Help us, O God of our salvation! And deliver us, because of the glory of Your name, and cover over our sins for the sake of Your name.

verses.text: Why should the nations say, “Where [is] their God?” Let it be known among the nations before our eyes, the avenging of the blood of Your servants that was shed!

segments.text: Why should the nations say, “Where [is] their God?” Let it be known among the nations before our eyes, the avenging of the blood of Your servants that was shed!

verses.text: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; by the greatness of Your power, preserve the sons of death.

segments.text: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; by the greatness of Your power, preserve the sons of death.

verses.text: And may You return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord!

segments.text: And may You return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord!

verses.text: Then we, Your people, and the sheep of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; for generation and generation we will declare Your praise.

segments.text: Then we, Your people, and the sheep of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; for generation and generation we will declare Your praise.
